summary: V6.25.53 Phase B (Evereantha cosmology hard-seed: quick-ref panel in Magic Architect + Cosmological Tension picker in Encounter Designer) — ALL GREEN end-to-end. Backend: 6/6 PASS (test_v62553_cosmology.py — payload shape 4 aurae+4 mortiscura+3 nodes each+legend; canon face ids luxantia/cryptosha/confluo/expanzis × obscuritia/spectros/exutus/stasis; 4 cardinal pairs return magnitude=advantage both directions; same-side fallback returns neutral with 'Fiction-led' note; unknown face → 404; no-auth → 401/403). Frontend (admin @1920x1080, /app/campaigns/af461ae0…/atelier → Worldbuilder Studio → Magic Architect): quickref panel renders (count=1), toggle expands body (count=1→1 visible), all 8 face buttons present (cosmology-aurae-luxantia/cryptosha/confluo/expanzis + cosmology-mortiscura-obscuritia/spectros/exutus/stasis all count=1). Clicking Luxantia opens cosmology-face-detail with exactly 3 cosmology-node-* children rendered; detail header 'Luxantia · LIGHT & LIFE' + flavor + 'CORE: LIGHT · LIFE · ENERGY · STRENGTH' + 3 node cards (Splendora etc.) — failure field text confirmed. cosmology-face-detail-close present, click returns count to 0. cosmology-legend present (count=1). Encounter Designer (live session 5cab71abc10b…): encounter-new-btn found inside SessionView once scrolled into view; opens AUTHOR ENCOUNTER modal containing CosmologicalTension picker. cosmology-attacker + cosmology-defender selects present (each count=1). All 4 magnitudes produced via value-set+change-event: luxantia/obscuritia→advantage, luxantia/spectros→edge, luxantia/cryptosha→neutral (same-side fallback), cryptosha/stasis→obstacle — cosmology-tension-result row + cosmology-tension-magnitude badge update correctly for each. Zero console errors (only benign React Router future-flag warnings). Regression: SessionView grid layout intact (DICE ALTAR + ENCOUNTER DESIGNER side rail visible), Encounter Designer modal backdrop renders above session content, no 'Compiled with problems' overlay observed on any visited route.

issues: Per-node fields are rendered as raw values (e.g. 'Splendora' / 'radiance, illumination…' / rank-1 & rank-3 text / failure text) without explicit 'Domain:' / 'Rank 1:' / 'Rank 3:' labels — the data is present and visually parseable, but a non-canon reader has to infer which field is which. Consider adding small label chips (DOMAIN · RANK 1 · RANK 3 · FAILURE) inside each cosmology-node-* card to improve scanability. Not a blocker for Phase B sign-off.

critical_code_review_comments: Backend opposition matrix is well-modelled: 20 pre-tabulated rows covering all 16 cross-side pairings (×2 directions) + 4 documented same-side returns. The synthetic neutral fallback w/ 'Fiction-led' note for same-side pairings is a clean approach — preserves the explicit/canon vs implicit/GM distinction without bloating the seed.
Magnitude legend is exposed alongside the matrix in the same payload — frontend can render the legend without a second round-trip. Good API ergonomics.
Cosmology endpoint is correctly auth-gated (401/403 verified) — even though the canon itself is non-secret, gating prevents anonymous scraping & enforces the broader API surface contract.

Frontend quick-ref panel correctly uses collapse-by-default UX (toggle to expand) — keeps the Magic Architect tool focused while still surfacing the canon when the GM needs it. Aurae / Mortiscura grids rendered side-by-side with consistent face-button styling.

Cosmological Tension picker integration into Encounter Designer modal is well-scoped: lives inside AUTHOR ENCOUNTER modal (not a separate dialog), uses controlled selects, fetches /opposition only after both sides are picked. Result row + magnitude badge update synchronously after change event — no race conditions observed across 4 trial combos.

Minor UX nit (see design_issues): node-card fields lack explicit per-field labels. Add Domain / Rank-1 / Rank-3 / Failure chip-labels for scanability — costs ~6 lines of JSX, big readability win for new GMs.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Magic Architect quickref: panel+toggle+8 face buttons+3-node detail+close+legend all verified; Encounter Designer picker: modal open + attacker/defender selects + all 4 magnitudes — advantage/edge/neutral/obstacle — produced and badge updates correctly)

context_for_next_testing_agent: V6.25.53 Phase B fully GREEN. Useful navigation notes for future Phase C agents: (1) Auth UI route is /auth?mode=login (not /login). Post-login redirects to /app. (2) Campaign route prefix is /app/campaigns/{id} (NOT /campaigns/{id} — the bare /campaigns path silently redirects back to landing even when logged in). (3) Atelier ▸ Worldbuilder Studio ▸ Magic Architect is the canonical path to the cosmology quick-ref panel — the standalone /writers/magic-architect route shows a 'pick campaign first' stub without a campId, and even with ?campId= the panel may not auto-mount because the writer guard re-checks campaign membership server-side. (4) Encounter Designer 'New encounter' button is in SessionView (live session route /app/sessions/{sid}), in the bottom 'ENCOUNTERS LIBRARY' card — not initially visible at 1080p, need to scroll down. The button is data-testid='encounter-new-btn'. Modal title is 'AUTHOR ENCOUNTER'. (5) For Playwright dropdown selection in modals, the documented evaluate(set value + dispatch 'change') technique works reliably for cosmology-attacker / cosmology-defender selects — select_option times out. (6) All 4 magnitudes are reachable: luxantia vs obscuritia (advantage), luxantia vs spectros (edge), luxantia vs cryptosha (neutral same-side fallback), cryptosha vs stasis (obstacle). (7) Phase C is Campaign export/import — no surfaces touched in this iter.
rca of the issue: No bug to RCA — Phase B implementation is correct as built. Two pre-existing testing-environment quirks worth noting (NOT bugs in V6.25.53): (a) 'Sign In' button on landing routes to /auth?mode=login (not /login), so direct /login navigation 404s into the SPA's catch-all and you have to start from landing. (b) /campaigns/{id}/atelier silently redirects to landing — the live route is /app/campaigns/{id} and Atelier is a sub-tab inside the campaign page (not a separate URL). Both are documented for the next testing agent.
